summary: PASS on candidate 0cab0a8c (562 files, source e3b2375a). All 26 assigned requirements are faithful to the playbook (B0009, B0018, B0023, B0029-B0043, B0048-B0051, B0056-B0065) and work in a live stack in EN and AR. Typecheck, build, lint, test (892/892) and contrast pass on Node 22 and Node 24. FE14 / D-076 works for the refocus path: /me goes first and the header changes with the data. Edit and archive still work, and an invisible-only reason is refused in both languages. One new Low, non-mandatory finding, F-DG2-570: within the 15 s fresh window, navigation in a tab whose user changed elsewhere fetches under the new identity while the header and permissions stay the previous one's. There is no disclosure and the server stays authoritative.
